answer.reason: JDG 6:24 states that Gideon built the altar at Ophrah and named it Jehovahshalom, which is a defining event for this object.

clauses.english: was built by Gideon at Ophrah to the LORD and named Jehovahshalom
clauses.quote: Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovahshalom

doubts: JDG 6:25-26 describe a different altar (to the LORD on the rock) and the altar of Baal, so they were left out.
